walk.c_order: SELECT c_order_id AS id, documentno, grandtotal AS amount FROM c_order WHERE c_order_id=101

walk.c_invoice: SELECT c_invoice_id AS id, documentno, grandtotal AS amount FROM c_invoice WHERE c_order_id=101 ORDER BY c_invoice_id LIMIT 1
